seo.title: Hydrate — Simple Water Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Log water in one tap and see what's left today. Streaks, Apple Watch, widgets and reminders, with optional Apple Health. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: WATER TRACKER
hero.title: Drink enough water, one tap at a time.
text: Hydrate tells you what's left today in plain words and logs a glass, can or bottle in one tap. Ink on paper, with color only on your goal. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection.

items.title: One-Tap Logging
items.text: Tap Glass, Can, Bottle or Large bottle, in ounces or milliliters. Any other amount, at any time, is one sheet away, for the drink you forgot to log.

items.title: What's Left, in Words
items.text: Today leads with "24 oz to go", then "Goal reached", with a ring that fills as you drink. Change or delete any drink, on any day.

items.title: Streaks and History
items.text: Your daily average, goal days, streak and personal best for the last week or month, with every day's drinks to look back on or put right.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Log a drink from your wrist, see what's left, and add a complication to your watch face. Drinks reach your iPhone even if it was out of reach for a while.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show what's left today at a glance, in your unit and your accent.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Connect Apple Health and every drink you log is saved there as Water, and deleted there when you delete it. Hydrate never reads your Health data.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark your goal. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widgets.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

items.title: Gentle Reminders
items.text: Reminders every one to four hours, between the hours you choose. Each says what's left, they stop once you reach your goal, and you can log a glass right from one.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your data stays yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No cloud sync. Your drinks stay on your device and your Apple Watch, and go to Apple Health only if you connect it. Zero data collection, period.

cta.title: Start hydrating.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
